name: eip1559_fee_burn_tip_cap_usd
question_template: A fictional blockchain prices transactions with a base-fee-plus-tip rule. A transaction consumed {GAS_USED} gas units. The block base fee is {BASE_FEE_GWEI} gwei per gas unit and the sender offered a priority tip of {TIP_GWEI} gwei per gas unit, subject to a max fee of {MAX_FEE_GWEI} gwei per gas unit. The effective tip per gas unit is the smaller of the offered tip and the max fee minus the base fee; if the max fee is below the base fee the transaction is invalid. Per gas unit, the base fee is burned and the effective tip is paid to the validator. 1 gwei equals 0.000000001 ETH, and the ETH/USD rate is {ETH_USD} USD per ETH. Report the effective tip per gas unit in gwei, the burned amount in ETH, the total fee paid by the sender in ETH, and the validator's tip in USD.

slots.description: Effective priority tip per gas unit after the max fee cap, in gwei
Total base fee burned for the transaction, in ETH
Total fee paid by the sender including burn and tip, in ETH

program:
def solve():
    gas = Fraction(P["GAS_USED"])
    base = Fraction(P["BASE_FEE_GWEI"])
    tip = Fraction(P["TIP_GWEI"])
    max_fee = Fraction(P["MAX_FEE_GWEI"])
    rate = Fraction(P["ETH_USD"])
    if max_fee < base:
        raise ValueError("max fee below base fee: transaction invalid")
    eff_tip = min(tip, max_fee - base)
    gwei_to_eth = Fraction(1, 1000000000)
    burned_eth = gas * base * gwei_to_eth
    tip_eth = gas * eff_tip * gwei_to_eth
    total_fee_eth = burned_eth + tip_eth
    tip_usd = tip_eth * rate
    return {
        "final": tip_usd,
        "effective_tip_gwei": eff_tip,
        "burned_eth": burned_eth,
        "total_fee_eth": total_fee_eth
    }
